title: Shop By Cannabis Category | CastleLeaf
description: Shop by cannabis category at CastleLeaf in Brighton, MA: flower, pre-rolls, vaporizers, edibles, concentrates, topicals, tinctures, accessories and more.
lede: Eight ways in, one friendly counter. Pick a category to learn the basics, then head to the live menu when you're ready to roll.

blocks.html: Whether you already have a favorite or you're starting from scratch, each category page covers what it is, how people choose and what to ask a budtender. When you know what you're after, our live menu shows what's in stock, and you can order online for pick-up in-store or Home Delivery. Partial to bulk flower? Mix and match our bulk flowers at the Flower Deli, right at our Fresh Counter.
